products.title: Belted Wrap Knit Vest
keywords: cute clothes for women in their 30s
products.short: A soft knit wrap vest with a wide shawl collar and a self-tie belt. Chest 40–46 inches, length 25 inches.
products.description:
A sleeveless knit cut like a wrap jacket: shawl collar, no buttons, and a self-tie belt you pull as tight as you want it. Tied, it has a waist; left open, it hangs long and straight over whatever is underneath.

The knit is soft and drapes rather than holds — closer to a cardigan than to tailoring, which is the point. It is the third piece that turns a tee and jeans into something you would answer the door in.

Chest 40–46 inches, length 25 inches. One size, in grey, navy and beige.

Over a long-sleeved tee in autumn, over a thin knit in January, over a blouse for the office. Korean fashion winter dressing runs on pieces like this, and it is one of the few cute clothes for women in their 30s that does not have to be either sharp or slouchy.

products.title: Kkongju Skin ACXII Acne & Brightening Soap
products.short: A cleansing bar with salicylic acid, made for breakout-prone skin and uneven tone.
products.description:
A salicylic acid soap in bar form — salicylic acid is the ingredient that works inside the pore rather than on top of it, which is why it turns up in almost everything aimed at breakouts.

Use it once a day to start rather than twice; a cleansing bar with an active in it is easy to overdo, and dry, tight skin is the usual sign you have.

Follow it with a moisturiser, and sunscreen the next morning.

It is the most-repurchased korean cleansing bar on our shelf, and the one customers come back for by name rather than by description.

products.title: AHC Premier Ampoule In Eye Cream 40ml
products.short: A collagen eye cream with an ampoule inside it, aimed at fine lines around the eye. 40ml.
products.description:
An ampoule suspended inside an eye cream — the ampoule is the concentrated part, the cream is what carries it and keeps it there.

T4 collagen is the active, aimed at the appearance of fine lines, with enough hydration behind it that the skin under the eye stops looking crepey by mid-afternoon.

40ml, which is a large tube for an eye cream and explains why most people end up using it on the whole face.

AHC is one of the better-known Korean houses and this is the product it is known for. The korean eye cream we sell most of.

products.title: ANJO Professional 365 Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ 70g
products.short: A light, non-greasy SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream with sodium hyaluronate and shea butter. 70g.
products.description:
Broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA+++ in a texture light enough to wear under makeup every day, which is the only test a daily sunscreen has to pass.

Sodium hyaluronate and shea butter keep it from drying the skin out, and tocopheryl is in there as the antioxidant.

No heavy finish and no white cast to blend away.

70g. The plain, untinted version of the ANJO BB cream — the korean sun cream for anyone who wants protection and nothing else.

products.title: ANJO Professional 365 Sun BB Cream SPF50+ PA+++
products.short: A tinted SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream that doubles as a makeup base, with hyaluronic acid, shea butter and green tea.
products.description:
A korean sun cream and a base in one tube. It gives SPF50+ PA+++ against UVA and UVB, and the tint is light enough to wear on its own or under foundation.

The texture is light and does not sit greasy. Hyaluronic acid, shea butter and green tea extract are in the formula to hydrate and soften, which is why it works as a primer rather than sliding under whatever goes on top.

Use it as the last step of a morning routine, and reapply through the day if you are outside.

A sun bb cream is the shortcut for anyone who has given up on a separate SPF and a separate base, and this is the one people repurchase.

products.title: Artisan Ribbed Knit Midi Dress
products.short: A heavy ribbed knit midi with a detachable knit vest over it, so one hanger gives you two ways to leave the house.
products.description:
The dress underneath is a plain long-sleeved midi in a heavy ribbed knit. The rib runs vertically, which is the whole reason it hangs the way it does — it falls from the shoulder without clinging anywhere on the way down. The waist is elastic, not seamed, so it sits where your waist actually is rather than where a pattern cutter guessed.

The knit vest over the top comes off. Worn together they read as one piece and the texture does the talking; worn apart you have a dress for the office and a vest for everything else. We have had customers buy it for the vest alone.

Three colours, all of them quiet: beige, brown, black. Sized S–M, and the knit has real give, so the span it covers is wider than the label suggests. It is the Korean fashion casual dress people reach for when they want to look considered and have eleven minutes.

As a petite dress long sleeve shape it works without alteration — the sleeve ends at the wrist on a shorter frame rather than past it.

products.title: Asymmetrical Tartan Pleated Midi Skirt
products.short: A violet, oat and honey tartan midi with an accordion-pleated panel down one side. 27.5 inches long.
products.description:
Tartan in deep violet, creamy oat and a golden honey, cut as a straight A-line — except down one side, where an accordion-pleated panel takes over. The asymmetry is the reason to own it: standing still it reads as a good plaid skirt, and it moves like something else entirely.

The waistband is fitted and sits at the natural waist, so a top tucks in cleanly. Length 27.5 inches, which puts the hem below the knee on most people. Polyester and rayon, which is what keeps the pleats sharp.

Two sizes, M and L on the waist.

A cream knit and ankle boots is the obvious way to wear it and still the best one — the skirt is doing enough. It is the Korean fashion skirt that solves the cute fall fashion problem of wanting pattern without wanting to think about it.

products.title: Autumn Explorer Utility Jacket
products.short: A boxy tobacco-brown utility jacket with a point collar, a chest flap pocket and tie-fastening cuffs.
products.description:
A warm mahogany brown, cut boxy and relaxed so a thick jumper goes under it without a fight. The collar is a sharp point — the one structured thing on an otherwise easy jacket.

The cuffs tie rather than button, so you set the sleeve volume yourself. There is a flap pocket on the chest in the workwear tradition and it is deep enough to be useful.

The fabric is smooth and high-density, crisp to the touch, enough to turn a breeze. It is a transitional jacket rather than a winter coat.

Sized L. Dark denim or a seasonal knit underneath. It is the korean fashion jacket shape that works on everyone because it is not fitted anywhere, and the single most useful cute fall fashion layer we have had in.

products.title: Beaute Angel Queen's Cushion #21, 15g
products.short: A lightweight cushion compact in shade 21, for full coverage with a radiant finish. 15g.
products.description:
A cushion foundation is the Korean answer to a liquid base: the product sits in a sponge, you press it with the puff, and you build coverage in thin layers rather than one thick one.

This one covers fully and finishes radiant rather than flat, with skincare ingredients in the formula so it is not simply sitting on top of the day.

Shade #21, which is the lighter of the two standard Korean shades.

15g in the compact. A korean cushion compact is the one piece of makeup worth carrying, because it refreshes a face in ten seconds without a mirror ritual.

products.title: Beaute Glutathione Vitamin Ampoule Balm
products.short: A solid ampoule balm with glutathione and vitamins, in a compact for targeted use.
products.description:
An ampoule in balm form, in a twist-up compact — which is the point: a glutathione balm goes in a bag and gets used on a specific patch rather than being decanted over your whole face.

Glutathione and vitamins are the brightening pair. Press it onto the areas that need it, over or under makeup.

It is the most portable thing on our skincare shelf and the one people buy a second of for a desk drawer.

A korean ampoule in a format that suits a day out rather than a bathroom shelf.

products.title: Beaute Vita Collagen Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+ PA+++ 45ml
products.short: An SPF50+ PA+++ tone-up sunscreen with collagen and vitamins, finishing dewy rather than sticky. 45ml.
products.description:
Broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA+++ with a tone-up effect — it brightens and evens the skin as it goes on, so it reads more like a base than a sunscreen.

The formula carries collagen and vitamins, and finishes dewy without the tackiness that puts people off a tone up sunscreen. Suitable for daily use on all skin types.

45ml, which lasts longer than it sounds because a tone-up needs less than a white cast does.

It is the korean sun cream for people who want one product between a cleansed face and the door.

products.title: Bonnyhill Strawberry Collagen Heartleaf Toner Pads, 60 pads
products.short: Sixty soaked toner pads with strawberry extract, collagen and heartleaf. For brightness and firmness.
products.description:
A collagen toner pad does three things at once: it tones, it exfoliates lightly as you wipe, and it leaves the essence behind on the skin.

Strawberry extract brings antioxidants and vitamins for brightness; collagen is there for elasticity; heartleaf is the calming ingredient Korean skincare reaches for when skin is irritated.

Sweep one over a cleansed face morning or night, or press it onto a patch that needs it for a few minutes.

Sixty pads in the jar. The korean toner pad is the format that has replaced bottled toner for most people here, and this is the one we restock most often.

products.title: Bonnyhill Ampoule Sheet Masks
products.short: Second-skin sheet masks soaked in concentrated ampoule — heartleaf, niacinamide or rice.
products.description:
A thin second-skin sheet soaked in concentrated ampoule, which is what separates an ampoule mask from the cheap sheet masks that dry out in ten minutes.

Three versions: heartleaf to calm, niacinamide to brighten, rice to soften. The serum absorbs fast and what is left is worth patting in rather than rinsing off.

Fifteen to twenty minutes is enough. Follow with a moisturiser to seal it.

A korean sheet mask is the simplest way to test whether an ingredient suits you before buying a full bottle of it.

products.title: Bonnyhill Honeybee Propolis Cream 170ml
products.short: A rich propolis, royal jelly and honey cream for dry skin and a stressed barrier. 170ml, all skin types.
products.description:
A thick, nourishing korean moisturizer built on propolis, royal jelly and honey extracts. It is the one to reach for when skin is tight, flaking or generally unhappy.

A propolis cream sits at the heavier end of a routine. Use it as the last step at night, or as the only step on a day when nothing else is going on.

170ml, which is a large pot — it will last a season of winter evenings.

Suitable for all skin types, though oily skin may prefer it only at night.

products.title: Bonnyhill Heartleaf Toner Pads, 60 pads
products.short: Sixty soaked heartleaf toner pads to calm, balance and hydrate irritated skin.
products.description:
Heartleaf — houttuynia cordata — is the botanical Korean skincare uses for angry skin, and a heartleaf toner is the simplest way to get it on your face.

These pads balance and hydrate as they tone, and leave enough essence behind that a serum is optional afterwards.

Use one morning and night over clean skin, or lay two on a red patch for five minutes.

Sixty pads. The plainest korean toner pad we carry, and the one for skin that reacts to anything with fruit acid in it.

products.title: Bonnyhill Rice Niacinamide Cream 100ml
products.short: A rice extract and niacinamide cream for hydration, tone and texture. 100ml.
products.description:
Rice extract and niacinamide in one pot. The rice is the antioxidant side; niacinamide is vitamin B3, which supports the skin barrier and is the ingredient most people are after when they buy a niacinamide cream.

The texture is a proper cream rather than a gel, and it absorbs without leaving a film.

100ml. Morning or night, after whatever serum you use.

It is the korean moisturizer to pick if you want one product doing a few jobs rather than four doing one each.

products.title: Celestial Midnight A-Line Gown
products.short: An ink-black A-line gown with ivory brushstrokes across the bodice, cut long with a soft pleated sweep.
products.description:
Black from the shoulder down, broken across the bodice by a band of ivory brushstrokes that look painted on rather than printed. The top half is a thick soft knit with real stretch in it; the sleeves and the skirt are a lighter corduroy that moves when you do.

The waistband is wide and elastic, which is what lets the skirt swing instead of hang. It is a floor-length cut with an accordion pleat, so it reads formal standing still and forgiving when you sit down to eat.

Bust 34–46 inches, waist 30–40 inches, length 42 inches. One size, and the range on those measurements is not a typo — the knit genuinely covers that much.

Two colourways, black and brown. It is one of the few petite dresses evening wear pieces in the shop that does not need taking up: at 42 inches it skims the ankle on a shorter frame instead of pooling. As a Korean fashion formal dress it is dressy without being fussy, which is a harder line to walk than it sounds.

products.title: Embroidered Fair Isle Knit Vest
products.short: A button-front Fair Isle knit vest with embroidered houses, wreaths and flowers, in off white, navy or red.
products.description:
A round-neck knit vest with a full button placket and contrast ribbed trim at the neck, armholes and front edge. The Fair Isle bands run across the chest, and worked into them are embroidered details and small raised appliqués — potted flowers, wreaths, little houses.

It is a proper piece of knitwear rather than a printed jumper: the motifs are stitched, so they will still be there in five years.

Soft breathable knit, light enough to wear indoors without overheating. Three colourways: creamy off white with brown trim, deep navy with red, and a crimson red.

Sized L. Over a long-sleeved white top and jeans is the standard way; over a collared shirt is the better one. It is the most cute clothes for christmas thing in the shop and it survives well past December as cute clothes for winter.

products.title: Belted Ribbed Knit A-Line Midi Dress
products.short: A black button-front knit midi with a buckled belt, gold buttons and white-trimmed pockets. Belt included.
products.description:
A soft ribbed knit in black, buttoned all the way down the front, with a V-neck and long sleeves. The four pockets are trimmed in white and finished with gold-tone buttons — small contrast details on a dress that is otherwise one colour from top to hem.

The belt comes with it. Buckled, it puts a waist on an A-line that would otherwise fall straight; left off, the dress reads looser and more weekend. Both work, which is why the belt is not sewn in.

One size, fitting up to a US medium. The knit smooths rather than grips, and it holds its shape through a day of sitting down and standing up again.

Midi length, so ankle boots and heels both work under it. This is the dress korean fashion shoppers come in asking for by description — buttons, belt, knit, black — and the one we reorder most often among petite dresses casual enough for a Tuesday.

products.title: Christian Dean Horse Oil Hand Cream 100ml
products.short: A rich horse oil hand cream for dry, rough or cracked hands. 100ml.
products.description:
Horse oil is high in essential fatty acids, and it leaves a protective layer on the surface of the skin rather than simply soaking in. That is what makes a horse oil cream the one to own for hands that crack in winter.

It works on dryness, roughness and chapping, and it is the cream to keep by the sink rather than in a bag.

100ml.

It is a korean hand cream with a short ingredient story and a long record, which is usually the right trade.

products.title: Wide-Leg Cargo Trousers
products.short: Soft wide-leg cargos with flap pockets and a drawstring elastic waist. Three sizes, three colours.
products.description:
Wide through the leg, gathered at the waist, with proper flap cargo pockets down the thigh. The fabric is soft and fluid rather than stiff cotton drill, so the volume falls instead of standing out.

The waist is elastic with a drawstring through it, which is what makes the size range as wide as it is: M fits a 26–38 inch waist, L a 27–42, XL a 28–43. Rise runs 14 to 15 inches and inseam 27 to 28 depending on size.

Three colours: khaki, beige and classic black.

Balance the volume with something fitted on top — a cropped top or a close knit — and chunky trainers or boots underneath. They are the korean fashion pants shape that has taken over the last two years, and among comfy cute clothes they are the pair you will keep reaching for.

products.title: Collared Half-Zip Knit Sweater
products.short: A soft brushed knit with a polo collar and a half zip, cut slightly cropped and a little oversized.
products.description:
A polo collar and a zip that stops halfway down — up for a high neck on a cold morning, down to show a tee or a chain underneath. It is the one adjustment the sweater offers and it changes the whole look.

The knit is soft and faintly fuzzy, warm without the bulk of a cable. Ribbed hem and cuffs, relaxed through the body, and cropped just enough to want a high waist under it.

Two colours: light oatmeal cream, and a deep charcoal grey. One size.

The cream with light denim is the easy version; the charcoal with black trousers is the one that reads as considered. For Korean fashion winter layering it does the job of a sweatshirt without looking like one — comfy cute clothes that can go to work.

products.title: DermaCrew Exosome All-In-One Ampoule
products.short: A concentrated ampoule aimed at firmness, pore size and collagen, built on a triple complex.
products.description:
The most concentrated thing on the shelf. An exosome ampoule is the newest end of Korean skincare, formulated around a triple complex aimed at firmness, pore appearance and collagen.

Use a few drops after toner and before cream, in the evening. It layers under everything else rather than replacing anything.

A korean ampoule at this strength is worth introducing slowly: a few nights a week until you know how your skin takes it.

It is the product customers ask the most questions about, which is usually a good sign.

products.title: Quarter-Zip Midi Dress with Heart Pull
products.short: A collared midi with a quarter-zip front and a small heart for a zip pull. Ivory or black.
products.description:
The shape is plain and the detail is not. A soft fluid fabric, an A-line that swings a little, a neat collar, and a zip that runs a quarter of the way down the front with a heart-shaped pull on the end of it. Zip it to the top on a cold morning, open it to the collarbone the rest of the time.

The sleeves are long with a small puff at the shoulder and a plain cuff. Nothing about it is loud, which is what makes the heart work — it is the only thing on the dress asking for attention.

Chest 38–42 inches, length 41 inches, cut to a US small. Ivory and black.

It is the kind of dress that solves an evening and a weekday with the same hanger: boots and a coat for one, heels and earrings for the other. If you want cute clothes to wear that still look grown up, this is the compromise. Among petite dresses casual pieces it is a safe one — 41 inches lands mid-calf rather than at the shin.

products.title: Ribbed Wide-Leg Lounge Trousers
products.short: Soft ribbed knit wide-leg trousers in black. Elastic waist to 32 inches, inseam 28.5, rise 12.
products.description:
Ribbed knit, cut wide from the hip down, in a flat black. They look like trousers and feel like the thing you change into — which is the only reason to own them.

The waistband is a thick smooth elastic that stretches to 32 inches and sits without digging in. Inseam 28.5 inches, rise 12 inches. Polyester, which keeps the rib from bagging at the knee.

Cut to a 25–26 inch waist.

A plain tee at home; a structured knit and loafers if they are leaving the house. Among comfy cute clothes these are the pair that passes in public, and as korean fashion pants the wide ribbed leg is the shape everything else is being cut against.

products.title: "84" Cropped Sweat Set
products.short: A cropped 84 graphic sweatshirt with matching high-waisted wide-leg joggers. Four colours, one size.
products.description:
A cropped sweatshirt with a distressed 84 across the chest, and wide-leg joggers cut high at the waist to meet it. Worn together they look planned; worn apart neither piece gives away that it came from a set.

The fabric is soft and breathable, with enough weight to hang rather than cling. The crop ends at the natural waist, which is what keeps the volume of the trousers in proportion.

Top: chest 42–50 inches, length 17 inches. Trousers: waist 21–34 inches, rise 16 inches, elasticated.

Four colours, including a sage green and a soft pink. One size. Among cute clothes sets this is the one that gets worn to the shop and then to brunch, and the comfy cute clothes benchmark for anyone who has decided tracksuits should look like something.

products.title: Short Trench Jacket
products.short: A cropped trench with a spread collar, contrast buttons and two large patch pockets. Chest 48 inches, length 28.
products.description:
All the parts of a trench — spread collar, full button front, patch pockets — shortened to the hip. It keeps the shape and loses the length, which is why it works over a dress as well as over jeans.

The buttons contrast against the body of the jacket, and the two patch pockets are big enough for a phone and a pair of gloves.

The fabric is durable without being heavy. Light enough for a crisp spring day, right for layering in autumn.

Chest 48 inches, length 28 inches, cut relaxed and sized L. Jeans and trainers, or over a midi dress for something more deliberate. As a korean fashion jacket it is the one that does not date, and for korean fashion winter it goes under a bigger coat without bulking at the shoulder.

products.title: Layered Crop Knit Sweater
products.short: A cropped knit with an embroidered script across the front and a built-in layer that hangs below the hem.
products.description:
A loose cropped knit with the look of two jumpers worn at once, except there is only one. The white hem underneath is attached, so the layered line stays where you put it instead of riding up your back on the train.

The script across the front is embroidered, not printed. It is raised enough to catch the light and it will not crack or peel in the wash the way a transfer does.

The sleeves are generous and the body is short, which is a shape that wants a high waist under it. Over wide trousers or a long skirt it balances; over low-rise jeans it will not.

Four colours — camel, black, ink grey and cream. One size, cut loose on purpose. It is one of those aesthetic cute clothes pieces that photographs better than it has any right to, and for Korean fashion winter layering it does the work of two pieces in one.

A note on the listing: the old shop had this sweater filed under a shirtdress name. The photographs were always this. The name has been corrected.

products.title: Melange White Straight-Leg Jeans
products.short: Light-wash straight-leg jeans in a pale grey-white melange. Rise 10.5 inches, inseam 31.
products.description:
A pale grey-off-white wash with a melange through it, so it reads as a soft neutral rather than a white jean — which is the difference between wearing them twice a year and wearing them weekly.

The cut is a relaxed straight leg falling cleanly from the hip, mid-rise at the waist. Nothing is tapered and nothing is skinny.

Rise 10.5 inches, inseam 31 inches. Cut to a 29–30 inch waist. Soft, durable denim with give in it.

A black tee and trainers is the whole outfit. These are the korean fashion jeans to own if you already have blue ones, and among korean clothes pants the pale wash is what makes a plain top look considered.

products.title: Ribbed Knit Maxi Skirt
products.short: A soft ribbed knit maxi with a wide elastic waist. Waist 26–36 inches, length 31 inches. Cream ivory or black.
products.description:
Fine vertical ribbing in a soft knit, falling straight to the ankle. The rib does the lengthening and the knit does the rest — it drapes rather than holds a shape, which is what makes it comfortable enough to wear for twelve hours.

The waistband is wide and elasticated, so it pulls on and stays where you put it without digging in anywhere. Waist 26–36 inches, length 31 inches.

Two colours. The cream ivory wants a chunky knit and boots over it; the black takes a tucked-in cami and sandals in summer and disappears under a long coat in winter.

This is the Korean fashion skirt people buy as a base layer for a whole season — comfy cute clothes that do not read as loungewear once there are shoes involved.

products.title: EKEL Hyaluronic Acid 4-in-1 Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++
products.short: A transparent SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream with hyaluronic acid, doubling as a moisturiser. No white cast.
products.description:
A hyaluronic acid sunscreen that goes on transparent — no white cast, no grey tone, nothing to blend out. SPF50+ PA+++ against UV.

The hyaluronic acid means it hydrates as it protects, so for a lot of people it replaces the moisturiser step rather than sitting on top of one. That is the four-in-one the name is talking about.

Non-greasy, absorbs quickly, and sits under makeup without pilling.

If you have skipped sunscreen because of how it felt rather than what it did, this is the korean sun cream to try first.

products.title: ESHUMI Vitamin Laser Sunscreen SPF50+ PA+++ 70ml
products.short: A lightweight SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream with vitamin E and hydrolysed collagen. 70ml.
products.description:
Lightweight and non-greasy, with SPF50+ PA+++ UVA and UVB protection. It absorbs fast enough to put makeup over it without waiting.

Vitamin E is the antioxidant doing the brightening work, and hydrolysed collagen is in there for elasticity. A vitamin e sunscreen is a reasonable way to get both steps in one, particularly in summer when a heavy cream is unwelcome.

70ml, which is the big tube — this is the one to keep in a bag rather than on a shelf.

One of the better-value korean sun cream options we carry, and the one that runs out fastest here.

products.title: Eshumi Vitamin Strong Protection Hand Cream
products.short: A fast-absorbing, non-sticky hand cream with vitamin E, hyaluronic acid and plant extracts.
products.description:
A vitamin hand cream that absorbs quickly and leaves nothing tacky behind — so you can use it and then pick up your phone, which is more than most of them manage.

Vitamin E against environmental stress, hyaluronic acid to hold moisture, and plant extracts for the rest.

It is the korean hand cream for a desk or a handbag rather than a bedside table: use it through the day as often as you like.

products.title: Cold-Shoulder Sweatshirt
products.short: A soft crew-neck sweatshirt with cut-out shoulders and a V-detail at the neck. Chest 27–42 inches, length 22.5.
products.description:
A plain crew-neck sweatshirt with the shoulders cut out and a small V at the neckline. It is one change to a shape everybody already owns, and it is the difference between a sweatshirt and a top.

Soft breathable fabric, relaxed through the body. Chest 27–42 inches, length 22.5 inches. One size, which the stretch genuinely covers.

Five colours — white, bold black, sunny peach, charming lavender and a fresh lime green. The brights are the ones that sell first.

Jeans, a skirt or shorts: it works over all three without needing anything else. Among comfy cute clothes it is the one you can wear out of the house without changing, and the cute clothes to wear option for a day that is too warm for sleeves and too cool for none.

products.title: For The Skin Collagen Gommage Peeling Gel 180ml
products.short: A non-abrasive peeling gel that rolls off as it dries, lifting dead skin. 180ml.
products.description:
A gommage peeling gel works by rolling: spread it on dry skin, wait for it to set, then rub gently and it comes away carrying dead skin with it. No grit, no scrubbing.

That makes it the exfoliant for skin that cannot take a scrub — and for anyone who has been told to stop using the one with crushed shells in it.

Once or twice a week is plenty. Collagen is in the formula to soften as it goes.

180ml, a large tube. The korean exfoliator we recommend first, because it is very hard to overdo.

products.title: Fleece-Lined High-Rise Corduroy Trousers
products.short: Deep brown corduroy trousers, fleece-lined, with a high rise and a straight leg. Elastic back waist to 32 inches.
products.description:
Corduroy in a deep organic brown, cut high at the waist and straight down the leg. The line is clean and does not taper, so they read as tailored rather than casual despite the cord.

They are lined with a soft fleece, which is the detail that matters from November onwards — warm without a thermal layer underneath, and smooth against the skin rather than scratchy.

Rise 12 inches, inseam 26 inches, with an elastic back waistband that stretches to 32 inches and keeps the front flat. Cut to a 27–28 inch waist.

Cream knits and charcoal both work against the brown. They are the korean fashion pants you wear when it is genuinely cold, and the most practical cute clothes for cold weather piece we stock.

products.title: Hera Cleansing Oil Set
products.short: A deep cleansing oil set with a 3-AHA complex, for removing waterproof makeup without a residue.
products.description:
A korean cleansing oil is the first half of a double cleanse: it dissolves makeup and sunscreen, which water and foam cannot, and then it rinses away.

This one removes waterproof makeup without scrubbing at the eye, and the 3-AHA complex — citric, lactic and glycolic acids — lifts dead skin while it works. It rinses clean rather than leaving a film.

Use it on dry skin, massage, add water to emulsify, then rinse and follow with a foaming cleanser.

A double cleanse is the single habit that changes most people's skin, and this is the set to start it with.

products.title: Striped Knit Cardigan
products.short: A horizontally striped knit cardigan with gold star-embossed buttons and a deep V-neck. Black or pink.
products.description:
Broad horizontal stripes on a dense, smooth knit — not fuzzy, and it keeps its shape rather than growing through the day. The V-neck is cut deep enough to layer a collar underneath without crowding.

The buttons are gold-toned and star-embossed, which is the detail that makes the thing: they do the work of jewellery, so the cardigan is finished with nothing else on it.

Soft knit with real stretch. Wear it buttoned as a top, or open over a blouse.

Two colourways — classic black with cream, and a pale pink with cream. Sized S–M. It is a cute clothes aesthetic piece in the proper sense: simple shape, one good detail, and nothing else trying. Korean fashion winter rails are full of these for a reason.

products.title: Heritage Crest Knit Dress
products.short: A fine-ribbed column dress in black or grey, with an embroidered crest at the shoulder and a pleated skirt.
products.description:
A fine vertical rib from shoulder to hem, which lengthens the line and gives the knit a tactile, slightly formal finish. The body skims rather than grips. The skirt below the waist is pleated, so there is movement where the column would otherwise be severe.

The crest at the shoulder is the detail that names it — embroidered, small, and the only ornament anywhere on the dress.

The waistband is elastic, which matters more on a fitted shape than it does on a loose one: the dress holds its line through a long meal. The hem sits below the knee.

Two colours, grey and black, sized S–M with the stretch to cover more than that. As a Korean fashion formal dress it does not need jewellery to make the case, and it is the chic dress to impress that does not announce the effort.

products.title: Heritage Check A-Line Midi Skirt
products.short: A forest green and ivory micro-check A-line with a flounced hem, fully lined, hidden zip. 26 inches long.
products.description:
A traditional micro-check in forest green and ivory, woven rather than printed, so the pattern has depth to it when you are standing close. The cut sits high on the natural waist, skims the hip, then opens into an A-line.

The hem is where it stops being an office skirt: a flounce around the bottom adds a tier of volume that breaks up the check. Fully lined, with a hidden zip at the back, so the waist stays smooth under a tucked-in top.

Length 26 inches, sized to a 25–26 inch waist. Substantial tweed-weight fabric that holds its shape all day.

For anyone shopping petite clothes for work and tired of the same three greys, this is a Korean fashion skirt that reads serious from the waist up and has an opinion at the hem.

products.title: High-Rise Straight-Leg Jeans
products.short: High-rise straight-leg jeans with an elastic back waist. Rise 11 inches, inseam 24. Two sizes with stretch.
products.description:
Sitting at the natural waist and falling straight from the hip — a clean line with no taper and no distressing, in a substantial denim that holds its shape through a day rather than bagging at the knee.

The back of the waistband is elastic, which is the detail that makes the sizing generous: the S stretches to a 27 inch waist, the L to 32. The front stays flat, so they still look like proper jeans tucked into.

Rise 11 inches, inseam 24 inches. Five-pocket styling with a smooth front over the hip.

That 24 inch inseam is unusual and worth knowing: these are cut short on purpose. For petite clothes for women it means no hemming, and they sit on an ankle boot the way they are meant to. The straightest, plainest korean fashion jeans we stock.

products.title: Holika Holika Soda Pore Deep Cleansing Foam 150ml
products.short: A foaming cleanser with baking soda, mineral water and tea tree oil, for oil and blackheads. 150ml.
products.description:
Baking soda beads and enzymes do the gentle exfoliating; tea tree oil handles the oil. A pore cleansing foam like this is for skin that goes shiny by lunchtime and collects blackheads around the nose.

It foams properly — a small amount worked up in wet hands is enough, and more than that will leave you tight.

Use it in the evening, and something milder in the morning if your skin is on the dry side.

150ml. A straightforward korean cleanser that has been in production long enough to have earned it.

products.title: Light Wash Wide-Leg Flare Jeans
products.short: Faded light blue wide-leg jeans with a high rise and a flare from the knee. Rise 13 inches, inseam 29.5.
products.description:
A faded light blue wash with the softness of a pair you have had for years. High-rise at the waist, generous through the thigh, then opening into a flare from the knee down.

The volume is the point and it needs the right shoe under it — a heel or a boot with some height, so the hem clears the ground rather than dragging.

Rise 13 inches, inseam 29.5 inches. Two sizes on the waist.

A fitted knit or a tucked-in tee keeps the proportion honest. These are the korean fashion jeans with the most attitude in them, and among cute clothes to wear they are the pair that makes you stand differently.

products.title: Varsity Bomber Jacket
products.short: A cropped microsuede bomber in camel or black, with white piping on the collar and pockets and striped ribbed trims.
products.description:
Matte microsuede, cut as a cropped bomber, with white piping tracing the collar and the slash pockets. The ribbed hem and cuffs carry a stripe, which is the collegiate part of the reference.

The buttons are chunky and vintage-looking rather than sporty. Mid-weight, so it is a jacket for a cool evening rather than a cold day.

Slightly relaxed through the body, which is what makes it layer over a knit.

Two colours, camel brown and black. Sized M. Jeans and a white tee is the obvious outfit and the piping is what lifts it. It is the korean fashion jacket with the most retro in it, and one of the most reliably aesthetic cute clothes pieces in the shop.

products.title: Plush Faux Fur Vest
products.short: A cropped sleeveless faux fur vest, open-fronted, in espresso brown, smoke grey, creamy white or black.
products.description:
Dense shaggy faux fur with real volume to it, cut short at the waist and left open at the front. There is no fastening, which is deliberate — it hangs better and layers over more.

The pile is deep and soft enough to pass at a glance, and it moves as one piece rather than flattening at the shoulder.

It gives you the warmth of a coat across the body without the bulk of sleeves, which makes it the layer that goes over a knit when a coat would be too much.

Four colours — espresso brown, smoke grey, creamy white and classic black. Sized S–M. The brown and black over jeans and boots; the white or grey over something you are wearing out. For cute clothes for cold weather it is the piece that does the most for an outfit, and korean fashion winter rails have been full of them for three seasons.

products.title: J.VITA Anti-UV Collagen Sunscreen SPF50+ PA+++
products.short: A waterproof SPF50+ PA+++ collagen sun cream with a fast-absorbing, non-sticky finish.
products.description:
Broad-spectrum SPF50+ and PA+++ in a waterproof sunscreen, which is the reason to pick this one over the rest of the shelf — it stays put through swimming and through a hot day.

Collagen is in the formula for elasticity, and the texture absorbs fast and finishes without tack.

Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

It is the korean sun cream for a beach day or a long walk rather than for a desk, and it is worth owning one of each.

products.title: Jigott Whitening UV Sun Block Cream 70ml
products.short: A 70ml SPF sun block with a brightening formula, for daily wear in the city or on the beach.
products.description:
A uv sun block cream in a generous 70ml tube — large enough to use properly rather than rationing it, which is the main reason most people under-apply sunscreen.

The formula is a brightening one, so it evens the tone as it protects rather than leaving skin flat.

It spreads smoothly, and it is as happy under makeup in the city as it is on a beach.

Jigott is one of the Korean houses the shop buys from most often, and this is the korean sun cream that comes back in stock fastest after it sells out.

products.title: Colour-Block Patchwork Cardigan
products.short: A knit cardigan in mismatched blocks — stripes on one side, pastels and a cartoon patch on the other.
products.description:
Every panel is doing something different. One side is yellow and white stripes, the other is blocked in pale blue and lilac, and there is a small cartoon patch on the chest that you will either love immediately or not at all.

It is knitted in blocks rather than printed, so the colours meet at proper seams and the whole thing has the slightly handmade look that makes patchwork work.

Soft knit, relaxed fit, sized S–M.

There is only one way to wear it: everything else plain. Cream trousers, white tee, done. It is the loudest cute fashion style piece in the shop and the one most likely to get a compliment from a stranger — properly aesthetic cute clothes rather than a safe approximation.

products.title: KISSERA Luxury Collagen UV Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ 70ml
products.short: A soft cream-type SPF50+ PA+++ sun block with aloe extract and a moisturising finish. 70ml.
products.description:
A soft cream type that spreads smoothly instead of dragging, with SPF50+ PA+++ protection and enough moisture in it that dry skin does not tighten under it.

Aloe extract is the soothing ingredient — an aloe sunscreen is the sensible choice if your skin reacts to the heavier chemical filters.

70ml.

It is the gentlest korean sun cream on our shelf and the one to start with if sunscreen has irritated you before.

products.title: KISSERA Pink Tone Up Collagen Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ 70ml
products.short: A pink-toned SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream with three forms of collagen, finishing dewy. 70ml.
products.description:
A pink tone up cream with SPF50+ PA+++ behind it. The pink cancels sallowness rather than lightening the skin, so the effect is a brighter face rather than a paler one.

Hydrolysed collagen, water-soluble collagen and collagen amino acids are all in the formula, which is why it suits dry skin better than most tone-ups do. The finish is dewy.

Soft cream texture, spreads easily, 70ml.

It is the korean sun cream to wear on a day with no makeup planned, and the pink is more wearable on more skin tones than the photographs suggest.

products.title: Kkongju Skin Collagen & Retinol Soap
products.short: A cleansing bar with collagen and retinol, aimed at tone, texture and fine lines.
products.description:
Collagen for firmness and retinol for texture, in a bar you use at the sink rather than a cream you have to remember.

A retinol soap is a gentle way into retinol, because the contact time is short — it goes on and comes straight off. That makes it a sensible first step if a retinol cream has stung before.

Sunscreen the next morning is not optional with any retinol, however briefly it sits on your face.

One of three korean cleansing bar options we carry from the same house, each aimed at a different thing.

products.title: Kkongju Skin Niacinamide Soap
products.short: A niacinamide cleansing bar for uneven tone and dark patches.
products.description:
Niacinamide — vitamin B3 — is the brightening ingredient here, and it is the gentlest of the three bars from this house: no acid, no retinol, nothing that stings.

A niacinamide soap can be used morning and evening without the dryness the other two can bring, which is why it is the one to start with if you are not sure.

Follow with moisturiser, and use sunscreen daily — tone work of any kind is undone by UV faster than it is done by a cleanser.

The mildest korean cleansing bar we stock.

products.title: Long-Sleeved Maxi Shirtdress
products.short: A full-length shirtdress in a light woven cotton blend, with a drawstring waist, chest pockets and side pockets.
products.description:
A shirt on top and a maxi skirt below, joined at a drawstring waist you pull to whatever shape you want that day. Loose for a hot afternoon, cinched for an evening, and nothing to adjust once it is tied.

The collar and the full button placket are proper shirt construction, with buttoned patch pockets on the chest. The sleeves are long and roll to three-quarter cleanly, which is how most people seem to wear them. There are side seam pockets at the hip as well.

The fabric is a light woven cotton blend — it drapes rather than stands, and the skirt gathers from the waist into a full A-line that moves when you walk.

Brown, beige and black. One size, cut loose. Among petite dresses maxi shapes this is the forgiving one: the drawstring sits where you put it, so the proportion works on a shorter frame without a hem alteration. A Korean fashion casual dress for a day that might go on longer than you planned.

products.title: Wide-Leg Ribbed Knit Trousers
products.short: Ribbed knit wide-leg trousers with a drawstring waist, in creamy white, oatmeal, heather grey or black.
products.description:
A ribbed knit cut wide from the waist to the floor, with a drawstring at the waist you can actually use. The rib runs vertically down the leg, which is what keeps the volume from reading as shapeless.

They are knitted rather than woven, so they move like loungewear and hang like trousers. The waistband is soft and flat under a tucked-in top.

Four colours — creamy white, soft oatmeal, heather grey and deep black. One size.

A fitted knit and boots is the version that goes out; a long tee and bare feet is the version that does not. These are the korean fashion pants most people buy first, and the comfy cute clothes benchmark the rest of the rail is measured against.

products.title: Faux Suede A-Line Maxi Skirt
products.short: A brushed faux-suede maxi with an elastic waist. Waist 26–32 inches, length 37 inches. Brown, beige or black.
products.description:
Brushed microsuede with the touch of the real thing and none of the care instructions. It drapes heavily, which is why the A-line falls in a long clean line from the hip instead of standing away from you.

The waistband is elasticated and smooth, so it pulls on and tucks under a top without a bulky seam. Waist 26–32 inches, length 37 inches — ankle on most people, lower calf if you are shorter.

Three shades: brown, beige and black.

It is an autumn and winter skirt and it behaves like one: a chunky knit and boots, or a fine black polo neck if you want the whole thing to read as one colour. Among cute clothes for winter this is the piece that does the most work for the least thought, and as a Korean fashion skirt it is the length that keeps turning up on everyone's feed.

products.title: I'm From Rice Toner 150ml
products.short: A dual-layer milky toner with 77.78% Goami rice extract. Fragrance-free and vegan. 150ml.
products.description:
A milky toner rather than a watery one, built on 77.78% Goami rice extract. Shake it before use — the two layers separate in the bottle, which is how you know nothing is holding them together artificially.

It hydrates deeply and balances oil and water, which makes it useful for dry, dull and combination skin alike.

Fragrance-free and vegan.

150ml. A korean rice toner is the first step most Korean routines take after cleansing, and this is the one people mean when they talk about glass skin.

products.title: Mela-X Tea Tree Brightening Foaming Cleanser 150ml
products.short: A mildly acidic foaming cleanser with tea tree, glutathione and aloe vera. 150ml.
products.description:
A tea tree cleanser with a soft, mildly acidic foam — acidic in the sense that it sits near the skin's own pH rather than stripping it, which is what a high-pH foam does.

Tea tree extract cleans the pores; glutathione and aloe vera are in there for brightness and moisture, so it does not leave skin squeaking.

Good for combination skin that breaks out but cannot take anything harsh.

150ml. The korean cleanser to pair with the Mela-X night cream if you want the routine to match.

products.title: Mid-Century Tweed Coat Dress
products.short: A cream tweed coat dress with braided trim, ornate buttons and patch pockets. Cut to a US small.
products.description:
Tweed in cream and beige with a faint chevron through it and a thread of something metallic that catches the light when you turn. It is a coat dress — collar, full button placket, patch pockets — so it wears like a jacket you do not have to put anything under.

The braided trim around the collar, the placket and the pockets is what dates it, in the good sense: it is a 1960s finish, done properly rather than printed on. The buttons are ornate and sit like jewellery down the front.

The waist is defined and the skirt flares gently from it. Cut to a US small.

This is the one people buy for a specific day. Among petite dresses for wedding guest options it is the rare one that is warm enough for a church in March and smart enough for the lunch afterwards, and it is a chic dress to impress without a single sequin on it.

products.title: Everyday A-Line Midi Skirt
products.short: A yoked A-line midi with deep angled pockets and a matching belt. Waist 24–36 inches, length 32 inches.
products.description:
A smooth tailored yoke across the top so there is no bulk over the hip, then a little gathering below it to give the skirt its flare. The shape is the plainest one in the shop and the most used.

The pockets are the detail that earns it: angled, utility-cut and genuinely deep, which is rarer in a skirt than it should be. A matching belt comes with it, for when you want the waist defined.

Back elastic waistband, so the front stays flat for tucking and the back gives. Waist 24–36 inches, length 32 inches.

Three colours — grey, warm tan and black. A striped knit and combat boots is one way; a silk blouse and heels is the other. As a Korean fashion skirt it is the quiet one, and it will outlast most of what you buy alongside it.

products.title: Midnight Cascades Pleated Midi Skirt
products.short: A black A-line midi with finely pleated tiers and a semi-sheer hem. Fully lined, elastic waist to 30 inches.
products.description:
Black, A-line, and quiet until it moves. The lower half is built in finely pleated tiers, and the last of them is semi-sheer — so the hem floats a beat behind the rest of the skirt as you walk.

Fully lined, which is what stops a sheer hem from being a problem. The waistband is a thick elastic that stretches to a 30 inch waist and sits flat under a tucked-in top. Length 33 inches.

Polyester, cut to a 27–28 inch waist.

It is a Korean fashion skirt that photographs beautifully and works even better in person, where the movement is the whole point. Among petite dresses evening wear alternatives, a skirt like this with a plain knit does the same job and you will wear it again on a Wednesday.

products.title: Glen Plaid Fringed Shacket
products.short: A charcoal and silver glen plaid shacket with a raw-edge fringe across the chest and marbled buttons.
products.description:
Half shirt, half jacket, in a charcoal and silver glen plaid woven with enough body to keep its shape. A band of raw-edge fringe runs horizontally across the chest — hand-finished, and the reason this is not just another check overshirt.

The buttons are oversized and marbled in an ebony swirl, high contrast against the weave. Pointed collar, dropped shoulders, cut loose through the body.

Side pockets are set in discreetly and the cuffs adjust on a button.

Slate, heather grey and white run through the weave, so it sits against cream knits and dark denim equally well. Sized L. It is the korean fashion jacket that does the work of a coat indoors, and a cute fall fashion piece that carries an outfit on its own.

products.title: Midnight Ribbed Knit Midi Skirt
products.short: A heavy-gauge ribbed knit midi in ink black. Elastic waist to 34 inches, 31 inches long.
products.description:
High-definition vertical ribbing in a heavy-gauge knit — enough weight to hold an A-line, enough give to sit down in without thinking about it. The rib runs the full length, which is what makes the line look longer than the measurement suggests.

The waistband is a stretch band that reaches a 34 inch waist and stays flat rather than rolling. Length 31 inches. Polyester, rayon and nylon, with the rayon doing the softness.

Ink black, one depth of it, no sheen.

This is the Korean fashion skirt that goes with everything you already own: knee boots in January, trainers in March, a slip of a cami in July. Comfy cute clothes that pass for tailoring from six feet away.

products.title: Midnight Velour Sweatshirt
products.short: A jet-black velour sweatshirt with a crew neck and fitted cuffs. Sized L, cut relaxed.
products.description:
Velour — the plush, slightly shining kind that feels like nothing else in a drawer of cotton. Deep jet black, so the sheen reads as texture rather than shine.

Classic crew neck, relaxed through the body, with fitted cuffs that hold the sleeve at the wrist instead of sliding over your hand.

Sized L.

It is a sweatshirt for staying in, and it will pass for a top with good trousers if the day goes differently. Among comfy cute clothes it is the softest thing we sell, and for cute clothes for cold weather velour does more than its weight suggests.

products.title: ANELY Calming Water Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++
products.short: A soothing SPF50+ PA++++ water-type sunscreen for sensitive and acne-prone skin. Two versions, calming and tone-up.
products.description:
A water-type formula that is light enough to wear over blemish-prone skin without clogging anything. SPF50+ PA++++, which is the highest rating on the shelf.

The calming version is the one for reactive skin; the tone-up version adds a brightening finish on top of the same protection. Both are non-irritating and hydrating.

A sensitive skin sunscreen in a water texture is the compromise most people are looking for, and this is the korean sun cream that keeps being recommended for acne-prone skin.

products.title: Plaid Wool-Blend Trousers
products.short: Charcoal, navy and ivory check trousers with a slim leg and a hidden elastic back waist. Inseam 23.5, rise 12.
products.description:
A woven check in charcoal, navy and ivory — a proper plaid with depth to it rather than a printed grid. The leg is cut slim and straight, which keeps the pattern from taking over.

High-rise at the waist, with a hidden elastic panel across the back so they sit securely without a visible waistband seam. Front fasteners are concealed, so the line over the hip stays unbroken.

Inseam 23.5 inches, rise 12 inches. Polyester, rayon and polyurethane. Cut to a 29–30 inch waist.

The short inseam is the point worth knowing: among petite dress pants for work these are one of the few pairs that will not need taking up. As korean fashion pants they are the tailored end of the rail, and the grey-scale base takes any colour you put above it.

products.title: Ruffle Hem Graphic Sweatshirt
products.short: A slightly cropped sweatshirt with a PARIS WATER POLO collegiate graphic and a contrasting ruffled hem.
products.description:
A retro collegiate print across the front — PARIS WATER POLO, in the faded way a real one would be — on a soft, slightly cropped sweatshirt.

The hem is where it turns: a contrasting ruffle runs round the bottom, and the drawstring lets you cinch it into a balloon shape or leave it loose and straight. Two quite different tops depending on which you choose.

Two colours, grey marl and crisp white. One size, relaxed.

High-waisted jeans, shorts or leggings. The combination of a sporty graphic and a ruffle should not work and does, which is what makes it an aesthetic cute clothes piece rather than a plain one — and the cute clothes to wear choice for a weekend that is not planned.

products.title: Parisian Tweed Mini Dress
products.short: A cream and beige tweed mini with a white Peter Pan collar, oversized contrast buttons and a pleated skirt.
products.description:
Woven tweed in cream and beige, fine enough to read as texture rather than pattern from across a room. The collar is a crisp white Peter Pan, which is the detail doing the work — it frames the face and takes about twenty years off the tailoring.

Down the front, a vertical placket with oversized buttons trimmed in contrast fabric. The skirt is softly pleated from a defined waist, cut short.

Sized to a US small, long-sleeved, lined where it needs to be. The tweed has a bit of body to it, so the skirt keeps its shape rather than collapsing.

Among petite dresses mini shapes this is the one that is short without being brief — the hem lands above the knee on most people rather than halfway up the thigh. A chic dress to impress at a lunch where you do not want to look like you tried, with bare legs in September and opaque tights by November.

products.title: Parisian Stripe Zip Cardigan
keywords: cute clothes for women in their 30s
products.short: A fine striped knit cardigan with a full zip and a stand collar, in red and cream. Viscose, polyester and nylon.
products.description:
Narrow stripes in red and cream across a fine, dense knit, with a full-length zip and a small stand collar. The stripes run horizontally on the body and change direction at the cuffs and the collar band, which is a small thing that stops it looking mass-made.

The knit has stretch and recovery to it — viscose for the softness, polyester and nylon for the shape. Ribbed trims at the cuffs and the hem.

Two sizes, M and L.

Zipped it reads as a top; open over a white tee it reads as a jacket. Either way it is the sort of piece that gets packed because it is warm, flat and goes with jeans. For Korean fashion winter it is the layer that does not add bulk, and it lands squarely among cute clothes for women in their 30s — colour without costume.

products.title: Bonnyhill Pink Piggy Collagen Cream 170ml
products.short: A pink collagen cream for face and neck, with hydrolysed collagen and a light rose scent. 170ml.
products.description:
Hydrolysed collagen and collagen extract in a pink, faintly illuminating cream for the face and the neck — the neck is in the name because most people stop at the jaw.

It is a collagen cream aimed at firmness and bounce rather than at hydration alone, and the finish is smooth rather than greasy.

A delicate rose scent, 170ml, suitable for all skin types.

The pot is large and the texture is rich, which makes it the korean moisturizer most likely to be bought as a present.

products.title: Pororo Sun Cream SPF50+ PA 50ml
products.short: A gentle SPF50+ sun cream with aloe vera and oak bark, free from artificial colours. Made for sensitive skin and children.
products.description:
A sensitive skin sunscreen built for the people who react to everything else: free from artificial colours, with aloe vera leaf juice and oak bark extract in the formula to nourish as it protects.

SPF50+ PA, and it holds up for long enough outdoors to be worth putting on properly.

50ml. It is formulated gently enough for children, which is the usual reason a household ends up with two tubes of it.

The mildest korean sun cream we stock, and the one to buy if you are choosing for somebody whose skin you do not know.

products.title: Prestige X5 Mela-X Night Cream 10ml
products.short: A concentrated night cream with licorice extract, arbutin, retinol and collagen, aimed at dull and uneven skin. 10ml.
products.description:
A small pot of a concentrated night cream. Licorice extract and arbutin are the brightening ingredients; retinol and collagen are the ageing ones.

It is a dark spot cream to use overnight and it is strong enough to introduce slowly: two or three nights a week to start, and sunscreen the next morning without fail, because retinol makes skin more sensitive to UV.

10ml, which is smaller than it looks and lasts longer than you would expect at the rate it should be used.

The most concentrated korean night cream we stock.

products.title: RE:DIUS Premium Vitamin Cream 50ml
products.short: A niacinamide cream for moisture, tone and texture. 50ml.
products.description:
Niacinamide, one of the B3 vitamins, is the ingredient doing the work here: it holds moisture in the skin, calms inflammation and evens tone over time.

Use a small amount, divided between forehead, cheeks, nose and chin, and spread it out from there. That is the way a niacinamide cream is meant to be applied and it uses half as much as scooping.

50ml.

A straightforward korean moisturizer with one active doing the heavy lifting — a sensible place to start if your routine has grown too long.

products.title: Christian Dean Secret Tone-Up Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ 70ml
products.short: A pink-tinted physical SPF50+ PA+++ sunscreen that doubles as a makeup base. With hyaluronic acid, glutathione and vitamin C.
products.description:
A physical sunscreen — the filters sit on the skin rather than being absorbed into it, which suits skin that stings with chemical ones. SPF50+ PA+++, lightly pink-tinted.

The tint does the tone up sunscreen job instantly, and the cream is light enough to wear as a base under foundation or on its own.

Hyaluronic acid, glutathione, vitamin C and a blend of twelve plant extracts are in the formula to moisturise.

70ml. A korean sun cream that behaves like skincare and finishes like a base, which is the combination most people are actually looking for.

products.title: SJM Medical Anti-UV Sunscreen Lotion SPF50+ PA 60g
products.short: A transparent water-film sunscreen lotion, SPF50+ PA, that finishes smooth rather than tacky. 60g.
products.description:
A water-film lotion rather than a cream: it goes on transparent and leaves the skin smooth instead of tacky, which is the whole argument for this one. A non sticky sunscreen is the only kind people reapply.

SPF50+ PA protection, from Dr.SkinCare in Korea.

60g.

It is the most expensive korean sun cream we carry and the one that converts people who had decided they hated sunscreen.

products.title: SKINPASTEL X5 Shaking Skin Toner 130ml
products.short: A retinol toner you shake before use, with niacinamide, hyaluronic acid and botanical extracts. 130ml.
products.description:
A retinol toner, which is an unusual format and a sensible one: retinol in a toner is lighter than in a cream and sits under the rest of your routine rather than on top.

The shaking is not a gimmick — the retinol and the hydrating phase separate, and shaking blends them fresh each time. Niacinamide and hyaluronic acid are in the second phase, with botanical extracts for antioxidants.

Start at two or three nights a week and build up. Sunscreen the next morning, without exception.

130ml. The most active korean toner we carry.

products.title: Wide-Leg Knit Set
products.short: A slouchy fine-knit jumper with matching high-waisted wide-leg knit trousers. Mocha, beige or black.
products.description:
A fine-gauge knit in two pieces: an oversized, slightly slouchy jumper and high-waisted wide-leg trousers cut from the same yarn. Monochrome top to bottom, which is what makes it read as an outfit rather than separates.

It is light, smooth and warm without weight — the sort of knit you can sit in all day and then leave the house in.

Top: chest 44–56 inches, length 26 inches. Trousers: waist 23–40 inches, rise 14.5 inches, inseam 26 inches. One size.

Three neutrals — mocha, beige and black. The jumper works with jeans and the trousers with a fitted top, so the set does three outfits rather than one. For korean fashion winter the knit co-ord is the whole uniform, and it is the most grown-up of our cute clothes sets.

products.title: Contrast Waistband Wide-Leg Trousers
products.short: Charcoal wide-leg trousers with a white waistband showing above the dark fabric. Waist 31, rise 14, inseam 28 inches.
products.description:
A white waistband sits above the darker fabric of the trouser, so it looks as though something is layered underneath. It is one piece — the contrast is built in — and it is the whole reason these are not another pair of black trousers.

The leg is cut wide and the fabric drapes rather than holds, so they fall straight from the hip and lengthen the line.

Waist 31 inches, rise 14 inches, inseam 28 inches. Two colours, black and grey.

A tucked-in blouse or a fitted knit lets the waistband do its work; anything long on top hides the only interesting thing about them. Among korean fashion pants these are the pair with an idea in them, and one of the few statement pieces you can wear to an office.

products.title: Tenzero Brightening Yuja Cream
products.short: A brightening cream built on yuja (Korean citron) extract.
products.description:
Yuja is the Korean citron — the fruit that goes into the tea, and a long-standing brightening ingredient in Korean skincare. A yuja cream is the gentler way to work on dullness, without the sting that a strong acid can bring.

The texture is a light cream rather than a heavy one, so it layers under sunscreen in the morning.

Pairs with the matching yuja toner if you want the full routine, though either works alone.

A korean moisturizer with a clear single purpose, which is what we look for when we buy skincare in.

products.title: Tenzero Brightening Yuja Toner 200ml
products.short: A brightening toner built on yuja (Korean citron) extract, for dull and uneven skin. 200ml.
products.description:
Yuja is the Korean citron, and a yuja toner is the gentle route to brightness — vitamin C-adjacent, without the sting or the oxidation problems that a true vitamin C serum brings.

It hydrates as it brightens, so it suits skin that is dull because it is dehydrated as much as skin that is dull from sun.

200ml, a generous bottle for a toner.

It pairs with the matching yuja cream. As a korean toner it is the easiest thing to add to a routine that already works.

products.title: Abstract Pleated Statement Skirt
products.short: A black pleated midi with a white architectural scratch print and a sheer black hem panel. Fully lined.
products.description:
White lines cut across a black ground like something scratched into a plate, and the pleating underneath keeps the pattern moving. Standing still it is graphic; walking, it is the whole reason the skirt exists.

The hem finishes in a panel of sheer black, so the pattern stops before the skirt does. Fully lined above it. A hidden side zip keeps the waist flat, and the wide black elastic waistband stretches to 30 inches.

Length 32 inches, cut to a 25–26 inch waist. Polyester, which is what holds a pleat this sharp.

Combat boots and a plain black knit in the daytime; heels and nothing else competing in the evening. If you buy one Korean fashion skirt a year, this is the kind that earns its place among the statement pieces rather than the basics.

products.title: High-Rise Flared Sculpt Trousers
products.short: High-waisted trousers with a slight flare at the hem, in a soft blue-grey. Inseam 27 inches, rise 11.5.
products.description:
Cut high at the waist with a contoured band that holds rather than squeezes, then falling straight to a slight flare at the hem. The flare is small — enough to balance the leg over a heel, not enough to be a bootcut.

The fabric has body to it and presses flat, so the front of the leg keeps its line through a day of sitting.

Inseam 27 inches, rise 11.5 inches, cut to a 27–28 inch waist. Soft blue-grey.

A ribbed knit tucked in, or a shirt left out — both read as considered. For anyone shopping petite dress pants for women and tired of a 32 inch inseam, 27 is the number worth knowing. As korean fashion pants they are the tailored pair that is not black.

products.title: Chevron Trim Knit Co-ord
products.short: A ribbed knit vest and matching A-line midi skirt, both edged in a monochrome chevron border. Grey or black.
products.description:
A ribbed knit vest and an A-line midi skirt, both bordered in a high-contrast monochrome chevron. The zigzag is the signature — it frames both pieces and is what makes the set look designed rather than matched.

Fine vertical ribbing through a high-gauge knit: slimming to look at, and it keeps its bounce rather than going limp at the hem. The skirt runs from a wide elastic waistband into a proper flare, with a drawstring you can use.

One size, fitting up to a US 12. Roomy, with real stretch.

The vest layers over blouses, tees and polo necks, so the set does not have to stay a set. Two colourways, grey and black. It is the most considered of our cute clothes sets, and a korean fashion winter outfit that needs nothing else thinking about.

products.title: Artisan Pleat Colour-Block Midi Skirt
products.short: A pleated midi in black with an asymmetric panel of cream and tan stripes running down one side.
products.description:
Pleated from the waist to the hem, in black, with one panel given over to vertical stripes in cream and tan. The block is off-centre on purpose — it drags the eye diagonally and makes a simple pleated skirt look drawn rather than bought.

The pleats are knife-sharp and hold through a day's wear. The waistband sits at the natural waist.

One size, midi length.

The trick with it is to wear nothing else with a pattern: a cream knit or a plain black top and the skirt does all the work. As a Korean fashion skirt it is the one people ask about, and it is a chic dress to impress answer for anyone who would rather not wear a dress.

products.title: Avenue Crest Long-Sleeve Dress
products.short: A navy long-sleeved dress with monochrome contrast trim at the neck, placket and hem, and pearl-effect buttons.
products.description:
Navy, long-sleeved, cut close without being tight. A contrast border runs the neckline, the central placket and the hem — one unbroken line from collar to knee, which is what gives the dress its height.

The buttons down the front are pearl-effect and catch the light a little. The cuffs are tipped in the same contrast as the trim, so the sleeve finishes deliberately instead of just stopping.

Cut to a US small. The hemline sits at a length that works in an office without reading as a uniform.

It is the piece to own if your week needs one thing you can put on at seven and still be wearing at eight in the evening. If you have been shopping petite dress pants for work and getting nowhere with separates, this does the same job from one hanger. As a Korean fashion formal dress it is restrained — the detailing is in the trim, not in the volume.

products.title: Slim-Fit Explorer Jeans
products.short: Slim-fit jeans in a sturdy denim with subtle whiskering, available in indigo and a faded light blue. Rise 10, inseam 31.
products.description:
A slim leg that follows the shape without gripping it — closer to a straight cut than a skinny, which is why they still look right now.

The denim is sturdy and has flex worked into it, so they hold a sharp line and still let you climb into a car. The washes carry subtle whiskering at the hip and the knee, the kind that comes from wear rather than from a machine making a point about it.

Rise 10 inches, inseam 31 inches. Cut to a 29–30 inch waist.

Boots, trainers or loafers all work under a slim leg, which is not true of a wide one. These are the korean fashion jeans for the days you want to put on trousers and stop thinking about it, and the most versatile korean clothes pants in the shop.

products.title: Beaded Side-Stripe Straight-Leg Trousers
products.short: Cream straight-leg trousers with a fine beaded stripe running down the outside of each leg.
products.description:
Cream trousers, cut straight, with a narrow beaded stripe set into the outside seam of each leg. The beading is fine rather than chunky and catches the light when you move, which is the entire ornament on an otherwise plain trouser.

The cut is a clean straight leg with no taper, which is what carries the stripe — a slim leg would crowd it.

Cut to a 27–28 inch waist.

A cream knit and a camel jacket makes the tonal version; a black polo neck makes it sharper. Among petite clothes for work this is the pair to wear when there is a dinner afterwards, and as korean fashion pants it is the quietest piece here with the most detail on it.

products.title: Burgundy Knot Sheath Dress
products.short: A wine-red sheath in stretch crepe with a twist-knot at the waist and a hidden back zip. Cut to a US medium.
products.description:
Deep wine red, cut as a sheath — straight, close to the body, finishing at the knee. The knot at the waist is the one piece of drama: a twist of the fabric that throws soft pleats across the midsection and takes the severity out of a pencil line.

The fabric is a stretch crepe with weight to it. It moves with you and comes out of a day's wear without the creases a lighter crepe would collect. The neckline is a plain round — deliberately empty, so a necklace or a scarf has somewhere to sit.

The zip is hidden at the centre back, which keeps the line clean from shoulder to hem.

Sized to a US medium. Among petite dresses special occasion options this is the desk-to-dinner one: it carries a meeting in the morning and a restaurant at night with a change of earrings. A chic dress to impress without a pattern anywhere on it.

products.title: Handmade Knit Blazer
products.short: A collarless knit blazer in soft cream, handmade in a 70% wool cashmere blend. Chest 42 inches, length 26.
products.description:
A blazer knitted rather than tailored: 70% wool in a cashmere blend, handmade, soft to the hand and with the drape that a woven jacket never has. It holds a shoulder line without any padding in it.

Collarless, with a clean V-neck, which leaves room for whatever is underneath — a shirt collar, a chain, a polo neck.

Chest 42 inches, length 26 inches. Sized L. Soft cream, which is the hardest colour to get right in a knit and the easiest to wear once you have.

It is the most expensive thing in the shop and the one that will still be in rotation in five years. For petite clothes for work a knit blazer solves the sleeve problem that a structured jacket creates, and as a korean fashion jacket it is the quietest piece we have.

products.title: Minimalist Trench Dress
products.short: A khaki-olive midi cut like a trench coat: notch lapel, button front, sash at the waist, soft A-line skirt.
products.description:
A trench coat that decided to be a dress. The notch lapel and V-neckline are straight off a coat pattern; below the waist it opens into an A-line that falls to mid-calf.

The waist is defined by a fabric sash, and you can run it either way — tied for a shape, left loose with the buttons doing the work for something easier. The sleeves are full length with a slight gather at the shoulder, enough to round the line without turning into a puff.

Muted khaki-olive, which is the colour that makes it work as hard as it does — it takes black, cream, brown and denim without argument. Cut to a US small.

This is a Korean fashion casual dress in the most literal sense: outerwear shapes worn as clothing, which is half of what makes the silhouette recognisable. Among petite dresses casual pieces it is the one that will go to work on Thursday and a garden lunch on Sunday.

products.title: City Fringe Knit Pencil Skirt
products.short: A black knit pencil midi with thick and thin vertical stripes and a fringed hem. Waist 26–32 inches, 30 inches long.
products.description:
A knit pencil skirt in black, striped vertically in a mix of thin and thick lines that are knitted in rather than printed on. The stripes lengthen the line; the pencil cut keeps it close.

The fringe along the hem is the part people notice. It swings a half-beat behind you and turns a sober shape into something with an opinion.

Elastic waistband, so it holds its structured look without being rigid about it. Waist 26–32 inches, length 30 inches.

One size. A tucked-in cream blouse by day and the same skirt with heels after six — it is a Korean fashion skirt that behaves like tailoring and wears like a knit, which is the best argument for it among petite clothes for work.

products.title: Cable Knit Hooded Cardigan
products.short: A full-zip cable knit cardigan with an attached hood, in creamy ivory, grey marl or black.
products.description:
Traditional cable knit, worked thick, with a hood on it and a zip all the way up. The cables are the real thing — raised, ropey and warm because of it rather than for decoration.

The zip means you can run it as a jumper, a jacket or something in between. The hood is attached and lined in the same knit, so it sits properly instead of collapsing flat on your back.

Three colours: creamy ivory, soft grey marl, classic black. One size, cut generous.

Jeans and trainers with the ivory; black trousers with the black, at which point it stops being casual. It is the warmest thing in the shop and the most obvious answer to cute clothes for cold weather — comfy cute clothes that you will wear until it falls apart.

products.title: Cropped Trench and Skirt Set
products.short: A cropped double-breasted trench jacket with a matching asymmetric mini skirt. Black or beige.
products.description:
Every part of a trench coat — wide lapels, storm flaps, double-breasted buttons — cut off at the waist, with a matching mini skirt underneath. The proportions are the whole idea: all the formality of the original, at half the length.

The skirt is cut asymmetrically rather than straight, which stops the set from reading as a uniform.

Two colours, classic black and beige. One size.

Together it is a complete outfit and the strongest thing we have ever stocked; apart, the jacket goes over jeans and the skirt goes under a knit. Among cute clothes sets it is the one with the most nerve, and the chic dress to impress answer for anyone who does not own a dress.

products.title: Cropped Utility Tie-Side Vest
products.short: A cropped sleeveless shirt-jacket in olive, with chest pockets and lace-up ties at both sides.
products.description:
A sleeveless shirt-jacket cut short, in a washed olive with a proper collar, a button front and two flapped chest pockets. The ties at both sides lace through eyelets, so you can cinch the fit or leave them loose and let it hang square.

It is built like outerwear and worn like a layer: over a white tee and jeans it turns the plainest outfit in your wardrobe into something that looks planned.

Cut to a US small, cropped at the waist.

The ties are the reason to buy it rather than any other vest — they are functional, and the shape changes completely depending on how you set them. An aesthetic cute clothes piece with some grit in it, and one of the few genuine statement pieces that still goes with everything.

products.title: Soft Stretch Wide-Leg Jeans
products.short: Wide-leg jeans in an ultra-soft stretch denim with an elastic back waistband fitting 25–32 inches. Rise 13, inseam 27.
products.description:
An ultra-soft denim blend with real stretch in it. They give where a rigid jean digs in, and the shape comes back rather than stretching out by the afternoon.

The back of the waistband is elasticated and fits a 25 to 32 inch waist, which is why they are sold as one size. The front is smooth and conventional, so from the outside they are simply a good pair of jeans.

Rise 13 inches, inseam 27 inches, cut wide from the hip down.

A crisp white tee and trainers in the day; a knit and a heel in the evening. Among comfy cute clothes they are the pair people buy a second time in another wash, and the korean fashion jeans most likely to be worn on a long flight.

products.title: Button-Front Mock Neck Sweater
keywords: cute clothes for women in their 30s
products.short: A fine-gauge knit with a ribbed mock neck and buttons running the whole way up. Chest 44–54 inches, length 22 inches.
products.description:
A turtleneck and a cardigan at the same time. The button placket runs the full length of the front and keeps going up through the funnel neck, so you can fasten it to the chin, open it to the collarbone, or undo the lot and wear it over a tee.

The neck stands on its own without the bulk a folded turtleneck adds. Ribbed hem and cuffs, fine-gauge knit, cut to skim rather than cling.

Chest 44–54 inches, length 22 inches. One size, in black, pink, grey and oatmeal.

It is the most-worn sort of thing we stock, which is not a complaint — among cute clothes for women in their 30s it is the piece that goes under a coat in January and over a dress in May. Korean fashion winter layering starts with exactly this shape.

products.title: Contrast-Stitch Knit Jacket
products.short: A knit jacket with bold contrast stitching, brass-toned buttons and flap pockets. Chest 40–46 inches, length 21.5.
products.description:
A substantial knit cut as a jacket — structure without stiffness, and enough stretch to move in. The contrast stitching traces the collar, the placket, the pockets and the cuffs, which is what turns a plain knit into something that looks made.
