Brass-toned buttons down the front, two flap pockets with matching button accents.

Chest 40–46 inches, length 21.5 inches. One size. Three colourways — deep navy, modern grey and classic black, each with its own stitch colour.

Denim and a tee underneath for the casual version, trousers and a polo neck for the other. For petite clothes for work it has the authority of a blazer and none of the bulk, and as a korean fashion jacket it is the piece that does smart-casual without trying to be both.

products.title: Full-Zip Windbreaker Jacket
products.short: A cropped full-zip windbreaker with a stand collar, elasticated cuffs and hem, and zip pockets. Chest 48, length 22.
products.description:
A smooth wind-resistant technical fabric, cut cropped and a little oversized, with a stand collar and dropped shoulders. It is light enough to carry and cuts the wind on a morning commute.

Full-length zip at the front, elastic at the cuffs and hem so it sits where you put it, and zipped pockets that will hold a phone while you run for something.

Chest 48 inches, length 22 inches. Sized L, in black.

Wide-leg denim and trainers is the straightforward version; over a dress is the better one, because the sportiness against something fluid is what makes the outfit. It is a korean fashion jacket in the most literal sense — the shape that turns up on every street-style feed — and among cute clothes to wear it is the layer you will actually grab on the way out.

products.title: Full-Zip Hoodie
products.short: A soft lightweight full-zip hoodie with drawstrings and front pockets, in wine red, black or white.
products.description:
A soft breathable jersey, cut with a gentle contour rather than straight up and down, and zipped all the way to the collar. Warm enough to be the only layer indoors, light enough to go under a coat.

The hood has drawstrings you can actually pull, the front pockets take hands, and the zip is metal rather than moulded plastic.

Three colours: a deep wine red, classic black and crisp white. Sized S–M.

Denim, yoga leggings or a mini skirt — it goes with all three and makes none of them look accidental. It is the most straightforwardly useful of our comfy cute clothes, and the one piece of cute clothes to wear that nobody regrets buying.

products.title: Executive Plaid Long Vest
products.short: A longline black and white check vest with fringed edges, velvet-trimmed pockets and contrast buttons.
products.description:
A micro-check in black and white, cut long — past the hip, so the line runs uninterrupted from shoulder to thigh. Collarless and open at the neck, which leaves room for a blouse or a polo neck underneath.

The finishing is where the money went: the edges are lightly fringed rather than hemmed flat, and the patch pockets are trimmed in black ribbon with contrast buttons on them.

Cut to a US medium. It gives a jacket's formality in summer and an extra layer over a knit in winter, which is a rare thing for one garment.

For petite clothes for work it solves the problem of a blazer that swamps you: there are no sleeves to shorten. One of the few statement pieces here that will go to a board meeting without comment.

products.title: Executive Pleat Trench Dress
products.short: A taupe double-breasted blazer top running into a knife-pleated skirt. Wearable as a dress or open as a coat.
products.description:
From the waist up it is a double-breasted blazer — wide notched lapels, tonal buttons, the shoulders cut properly. From the waist down it is a knife-pleated skirt with real swing in it. The join is the whole idea.

The fabric has enough substance to hold the pleats sharp through a day of sitting, and it drapes rather than stands away from you. Soft taupe-beige, which is a kinder neutral than grey and less stark than black.

Two ways to wear it: buttoned as a dress, or left open over a knit and trousers, at which point it reads as a trench. Cut to a US small.

If you have ever stood in front of a chic attire dress code on an invitation and had no idea what it meant, this answers it. As a Korean fashion formal dress it is tailored without being stiff — the pleats keep it from ever looking like a suit.

products.title: Seafoam Mohair-Blend Cardigan
products.short: A fuzzy mint-green cardigan with a deep V-neck, drop shoulders and three oversized tortoiseshell buttons.
products.description:
A plush, haloed knit in a soft seafoam mint — light to wear and warmer than it looks, with the faint fuzz that a mohair blend gives you. It has some stretch in it, so the shape comes back after a day's wear.

Three oversized marbled amber buttons do all the fastening, and the contrast against the mint is the detail the whole piece hangs on. The shoulders are dropped and the body slouches on purpose. Deep ribbed cuffs gather the sleeve so it billows a little above the wrist.

The V-neck is cut low and clean, which is why a plain white tee underneath looks deliberate rather than accidental.

Sized L, cut relaxed. A proper aesthetic cute clothes piece — colour, texture and nothing else going on — and among comfy cute clothes it is the one you will put on the moment you get home.

products.title: "Tomatoes" Embroidered Knit Vest
products.short: A sleeveless knit vest embroidered with cherry tomatoes on the vine and the word Tomatoes above them.
products.description:
Red cherry tomatoes stitched on the vine across the front, with the word Tomatoes embroidered in green above them. It is silly in the way that good knitwear is sometimes silly, and the embroidery is proper — raised, hand-finished, not a transfer.

The vest underneath is a plain soft knit, sleeveless, cut to layer. A crisp white shirt under it is the obvious pairing and still the best; a long-sleeved tee works for the school run.

Two colours: creamy ivory and a soft heather grey. One size.

It is the piece people photograph. If you like your cute clothes to wear to have a joke in them rather than a slogan, this is the one — genuinely aesthetic cute clothes rather than a print pretending to be.

products.title: Heirloom Bloom Embroidered Knit Vest
keywords: cute clothes for women in their 30s
products.short: A soft V-neck knit vest with floral embroidery trailing down the front, in heather grey or soft lilac.
products.description:
Floral embroidery in a contrasting thread runs down the front of the vest, following the button placket rather than sitting in a block. The effect is closer to something inherited than something bought, which is where the name comes from.

The knit is plush and fine, warm without bulk. Ribbed V-neck, hem and armholes keep the edges structured so it does not cling or stretch out of shape over a shirt.

Two colours: a classic heather grey, and a soft lilac that does more than it sounds like it will against cream and camel.

One size. Over a polo neck in winter, over a white shirt the rest of the year. For Korean fashion winter it is the layer that adds an idea rather than a jumper, and it sits comfortably among cute clothes for women in their 30s — pretty without being girlish.

products.title: Corduroy Overshirt
products.short: A fine-wale corduroy overshirt cut oversized and long. Chest 44 inches, length 26. Taupe or terracotta red.
products.description:
Fine-wale corduroy, soft to the hand, cut generous and a little longer than a shirt. Buttoned it is a shirt, open it is a light jacket, and the extended length is what makes the second reading work.

The cord has enough body to hold a shoulder but drapes rather than stands away from you.

Chest 44 inches, length 26 inches. One size.

Two colours: a warm taupe-camel, and a deep terracotta red. A knit tied over the shoulders is the way it is photographed and it is a good way. Over denim, trousers or leggings it does the same job. As a korean fashion jacket it is the lightest thing we carry, and it is the cute fall fashion layer for days that cannot decide.

products.title: Wide-Wale Corduroy Wide-Leg Trousers
products.short: Heavy wide-wale corduroy trousers, high-rise with a sweeping wide leg. Rise 15.5 inches, inseam 29.
products.description:
Wide-wale corduroy with real weight to it. The deep ribs throw a shadow and catch the light, which is why a plain trouser in this fabric reads as anything but plain.

It has give where denim does not — the drape is soft and the leg swings rather than holds its shape rigidly. High-rise waist, then a wide leg all the way down.

Front zip and button closure, proper trouser construction. Rise 15.5 inches, inseam 29 inches. Cut to a 31–32 inch waist.

A fine knit tucked in keeps the proportion; anything bulky on top and the whole outfit becomes volume. They are the warmest korean fashion pants we stock and the obvious answer to cute clothes for cold weather when a skirt is not happening.

products.title: Highland Plaid Tiered Maxi Skirt
products.short: A cerulean, teal and forest plaid maxi in two gathered tiers. Waist 26–30 inches, length 33.5 inches.
products.description:
Tartan in cool jewel tones — cerulean, deep teal, forest green — cut on a slight diagonal so the lines layer rather than line up. It is the most colourful skirt in the shop and still reads as a neutral once there is a white shirt above it.

Two gathered tiers give it the volume. The lower tier is softly ruffled, which is why it swings as much as it does.

Back elastic waistband, flat at the front. Waist 26–30 inches, length 33.5 inches. One size.

A white shirt and boots is the version in the photographs and it is the right one. For cute fall fashion this is the piece that makes an outfit out of a plain top, and it is the Korean fashion skirt people stop you about on the street.

products.title: Knitted Fringe Midi Skirt
products.short: A soft knit A-line midi with a fringed hem, in creamy beige, grey or black. Elastic waist.
products.description:
A fine vertical knit — something between a herringbone and a rib — cut as an A-line that falls past the knee. Soft enough to pull on without thinking, with enough drape to hang properly rather than cling.

The fringe at the hem is what takes it out of the basics drawer. It adds movement and a hand-finished look that a plain knit skirt does not have.

Elastic waistband all the way round, so it pulls on and adapts. Three colours: creamy beige, grey, black. One size.

A chunky knit and boots in autumn; a fitted tee and sandals when it is warm. It is the Korean fashion skirt that quietly becomes the most-worn thing you own, and among comfy cute clothes it is the one that still looks deliberate.

products.title: Midnight Wide-Leg Jeans
products.short: Deep indigo wide-leg jeans cut high at the waist and falling straight and full to the hem.
products.description:
A deep indigo with almost no fading in it — the darkest denim in the shop, and the one that passes in places jeans usually do not.

High at the waist, full through the leg, falling straight to the hem without a flare. The weight of the denim is what keeps the volume hanging rather than billowing.

Cut to a 29–30 inch waist.

Dark denim takes a heel and a blazer as easily as it takes trainers, which is the argument for owning one pair this colour. As korean fashion jeans these are the formal end of the rail, and among korean clothes pants the pair most likely to be worn somewhere that has a dress code.

products.title: Tailored Camel Stretch Trousers
products.short: Camel-brown tailored trousers in a smooth stretch blend, mid-to-high rise with a straight ankle.
products.description:
Cut close through the thigh and then straight to the ankle, with a mid-to-high rise that sits at the narrowest part of the waist. The line from hip to hem is one continuous one, which is the whole job of a tailored trouser.

The fabric is a smooth stretch blend that resists creasing and keeps its press through a day of sitting. It moves with you rather than holding you.

A warm camel-tobacco brown that goes with white, black, navy and anything jewel-toned. Cut to a 27–28 inch waist.

For petite dress pants for work the ankle-length cut is the useful part: they are meant to end above the shoe, so a shorter leg reads as the design rather than an alteration you did not make. As korean fashion pants they are the quietest pair here and probably the most worn.

products.title: Oversized Brushed Flannel Shirt
products.short: A soft brushed flannel in oversized plaid, with button cuffs and a chest pocket. Chest 48 inches, length 28.
products.description:
Brushed flannel, soft from the first wear rather than the fiftieth, cut generously oversized so it drapes instead of fitting. The plaid runs through earthy tan, slate grey and a denim blue in the main colourway.

Classic button front, button cuffs, one working chest pocket. Chest 48 inches, length 28 inches, one size.

Six colourways in all — mustard, navy, pink, dark brown, sky blue and a hot pink.

Buttoned with jeans, open over a white tee, or tied round the waist when the afternoon warms up. It is the most-worn of our comfy cute clothes and the obvious cute clothes for winter layer for anyone who does not want a coat indoors.

products.title: Satin Crest Blouse
products.short: A satin blouse with a crest motif, cut loose with a soft drape. Sized M–L.
products.description:
Satin with a soft, heavy drape rather than a stiff shine — it falls from the shoulder and gathers at the cuff instead of holding a shape of its own. The crest motif is the only pattern on it.

Cut loose through the body, long enough to tuck or to leave out, and it presses flat without a fight.

Sized M–L.

Tucked into tailored trousers it reads as the dressy half of an outfit; left out over jeans it reads as considered rather than casual. For petite clothes for work a loose satin blouse sits better than a fitted shirt, and it is the chic dress to impress answer for an evening that follows a working day.

products.title: Rib-Knit Hooded Lounge Set
products.short: A half-zip hooded rib-knit top with matching wide-leg trousers. Mocha, black or beige.
products.description:
A soft breathable rib-knit in two pieces. The top is hooded with a half zip, so it runs from a high cosy neck to an open collar depending on how far you pull it, with drawstrings at the hood.

The trousers are wide-leg and drape properly, which is the difference between a lounge set and a tracksuit.

Top: chest 48–64 inches, length 26.5 inches. Trousers: waist 24–40 inches, inseam 27 inches. One size, cut generous.

Three neutrals — beige, mocha and black. Worn together it is a coherent outfit for a day of errands; the hoodie on its own goes with jeans. It is the most comfortable thing we sell, and the cute clothes sets option for people who want comfy cute clothes without a graphic on them.

products.title: Sailor Collar Midi Dress
keywords: cute clothes for women in their 30s
products.short: A warm beige midi with an oversized sailor collar, a self-tie belt, an exposed front zip and a pleated skirt.
products.description:
The collar is the point: oversized, sailor-cut, sitting wide across the shoulders and framing everything above it. The rest of the dress is deliberately quiet so the collar has room to be the loud part.

A fitted waist with a self-tie belt, a pleated A-line skirt below it, and an exposed zip down the front that is both the fastening and the only hardware on the piece. Long tailored sleeves with neat cuffs.

Smooth structured fabric in a warm beige — the kind of neutral that looks expensive next to brown, tan and cream and holds its own against black.

Cut to a US medium, midi length. It lands in the gap most of us are shopping in: cute clothes for women in their 30s that do not borrow from either direction. Among petite dresses casual pieces it is the one you can wear to a christening and then to the pub.

products.title: Cashmere-Blend Knit Jogger
products.short: Soft cashmere-blend joggers with deep side pockets and a drawstring waist. Waist 24–34, rise 15, inseam 25.
products.description:
A fine cashmere-blend knit, soft enough that the first thing anyone does is put a hand on them. Warm without bulk, with enough stretch to sit cross-legged in.

The shape is a relaxed jogger that tapers towards the ankle with a soft cuff — the kind that stays rolled if you roll it. The side pockets are deep and real, not decorative.

Elastic drawstring waist. Waist 24–34 inches, rise 15 inches, inseam 25 inches. One size.

Three colours, including a tangerine that is the loudest thing on the rail and surprisingly easy to wear with cream or grey. They are the comfy cute clothes pair you will reach for daily, and as korean fashion pants the knit jogger has quietly replaced the tracksuit bottom.

products.title: Olive Straight-Leg Travel Trousers
products.short: Olive-green straight-leg trousers with stretch, mid-to-high rise, falling to the ankle. Rise 12.5, inseam 28.
products.description:
Olive green — the shade that behaves like a neutral but is not black. It takes white, cream, black, and any of the bright oranges and soft pastels you put against it.

The cut is a straight leg from a mid-to-high rise, falling neatly to the ankle without clinging through the thigh. The fabric is smooth and substantial, holds a shape, and comes out of a suitcase without much to answer for.

There is real stretch in it, which is the difference between a work trouser and one you can sit on a train in for four hours.

Rise 12.5 inches, inseam 28 inches, cut to a 27–28 inch waist. Among petite dress pants for women the ankle-length straight leg is the most forgiving shape there is, and as korean fashion pants these are the pair that will do a week away on their own.

products.title: Teddy Bear Knit Vest
products.short: A soft fluffy knit vest with a teddy bear in a little hoodie worked into the front. Chest 44–56 inches, length 23 inches.
products.description:
A teddy bear, in a small hoodie of his own, knitted into the front of a soft fluffy vest. He is woven in rather than printed on, so he will not crack, peel or go through the wash badly.

The knit is gentle and breathable — light enough to wear over a shirt indoors without cooking, warm enough to be the extra layer in October.

Chest 44–56 inches, length 23 inches. One size, cut generous.

Over a crisp white tee, a long-sleeved top, or a collared shirt if you want the preppy version. It is the single most asked-about thing in the shop. If your taste in cute clothes to wear runs to things that make people smile at you on the bus, this is the one — aesthetic cute clothes with a sense of humour.

products.title: Terracotta Crochet Midi Skirt
products.short: A rust-toned pointelle crochet midi in tiered bands, fully lined. Length 33 inches, acrylic with a polyester lining.
products.description:
Crochet-look pointelle knit with open cut-outs through it, built in horizontal bands that each use a different stitch. The effect is lace without being delicate about it — and it is fully lined, so the openwork is texture rather than transparency.

The colour is a warm sun-faded rust that sits well against cream, white and every shade of brown.

The waistband is a wide ribbed elastic that sits high and cinches. Length 33 inches, mid-calf on most people. Acrylic, with a polyester lining.

Two sizes on the waist. It is the one people pack: among cute clothes for vacation it does dinner, a walk and a market with one change of shoes, and as a Korean fashion skirt it is the most textural thing in the shop.

products.title: Mermaid Hem Ribbed Knit Skirt
products.short: A ribbed knit midi in warm brown with a flared mermaid hem and a faint allover shimmer. Elastic waist to 34 inches.
products.description:
Ribbed knit, close through the hip and thigh, then flaring out below the knee — the mermaid line, done in a knit so it moves instead of holding its shape rigidly.

There is a shimmer worked through the yarn. It is not a sequin or a print; it catches the light as you turn and disappears when you stand still.

A wide ribbed elastic waistband that stretches to a 34 inch waist. Length 32 inches. Rayon and nylon, which is where the softness and the stretch come from.

Warm brown, cut to a 27–28 inch waist. It is a Korean fashion skirt with a silhouette that does most of the work, and a chic dress to impress alternative for anyone who would rather wear two pieces.

products.title: Terracotta Wrap-Front Pencil Skirt
products.short: A burnt sienna pencil skirt with an asymmetric wrap panel, a high sculpted waist and a hidden back zip. 26 inches long.
products.description:
Burnt sienna — a warm terracotta that does more for a cream silk shirt than black ever will. The front is an overlapping wrap panel set off-centre, which draws a diagonal across a shape that is otherwise all vertical lines.

The waistband is wide and sculpted, sitting at the narrowest part. A short front slit at the hem lets you walk properly. At the back, slim vertical darts shape it to the body, and the zip is hidden so nothing interrupts the line.

Polyester, rayon and polyurethane, which is a blend that holds a crease out rather than in. Length 26 inches, cut to a 27–28 inch waist.

Cream silk, a black knit, or tonal leather — all three work. For petite clothes for work this is the Korean fashion skirt that is a colour instead of a compromise.

products.title: Wide-Leg Knit Trousers with Button Slits
products.short: Soft knit wide-leg trousers with side slits and three contrast buttons at the hem. Waist 24–32, rise 13, inseam 29.
products.description:
A soft breathable knit cut wide and flowing from a drawstring waist. They move like loungewear and photograph like trousers, which is the entire reason they sell.

The detail is at the bottom: a side slit on each leg finished with three contrasting buttons. It breaks the line of the hem and shows whatever is on your feet, which a wide leg usually swallows.

Elastic drawstring waist. Waist 24–32 inches, rise 13 inches, inseam 29 inches. One size, in grey, beige, black and ivory.

A tucked-in blouse and heels dresses them up; a plain tee does not. They are the korean fashion pants that get worn to the airport and to dinner in the same week, and the comfy cute clothes pair most likely to need replacing from use.

products.title: Utility Jacket and Cargo Skirt Set
products.short: A cropped zip-front utility jacket with chest pockets and a matching midi skirt with a cargo pocket.
products.description:
A cropped zip-front jacket with a stand collar, chest pockets and a drawstring hem you pull to set the shape. It is sporty without being sportswear.

The matching midi skirt has an elasticated waist, a chain detail at the front and a working cargo pocket on the thigh — a streamlined cut rather than a full one, so it moves cleanly.

One size.

Together they read as a considered utility outfit; the jacket on its own goes over a dress and the skirt under a knit. It is the most aesthetic cute clothes thing on the rail if your taste runs to technical rather than pretty, and the only one of our cute clothes sets with pockets in both halves.

products.title: Fine-Wale Corduroy Cargo Trousers
products.short: Harvest-gold fine-wale corduroy cargos with a wide leg and an elastic waist. Waist 26–36, rise 12, inseam 27.
products.description:
Fine-wale corduroy in a warm harvest gold — a yellow-olive that is more wearable than it sounds and does something good next to cream, brown and black alike.

The cut is a generous wide leg with cargo pockets on it, so there is utility detail without the stiffness of cotton drill. The cord is soft and catches the light along the wales.

Elastic waistband. Waist 26–36 inches, rise 12 inches, inseam 27 inches. One size.

Something fitted on top, always — the leg is doing enough. For cute fall fashion this is the colour of the season every season, and as korean fashion pants the cargo-meets-cord combination is the one that keeps selling out.

products.title: Cropped Full-Zip Hoodie Set
products.short: A cropped full-zip hoodie with matching wide-leg trousers. Blue, grey, melange grey or black.
products.description:
A cropped hoodie with a full zip, and wide-leg trousers cut to meet it. Zipped it is one outfit; open over a tee it is another, and the trousers go on their own with anything.

Soft and warm without weight, relaxed through the body rather than fitted anywhere.

Top: chest 38-46 inches, length 19 inches. Trousers: waist 21-34 inches, rise 16 inches, inseam 27 inches. One size.

Four colours, including two greys different enough to own both. It is the set that gets worn to the school run and then all day, and the warmest of our comfy cute clothes. Among cute clothes sets it is the one with a zip, which matters more than it sounds in a week of changing weather.

products.title: "Unavailable" Tiered Sweatshirt Dress
products.short: A long sweatshirt dress with a tiered skirt and UNAVAILABLE — PRIVATE REASONS printed across the chest.
products.description:
A sweatshirt on top, a tiered skirt below, and a printed crest across the chest that reads UNAVAILABLE, PRIVATE REASONS. It is a joke worn at a distance, which is the best kind.

The tiers start below the hip and give the whole thing a shape, so it does not just hang the way a long sweatshirt does. Long sleeves, dropped shoulder, loose through the body.

Two colours, black and oatmeal, in an XL that runs generous — this is a piece cut to be lived in rather than fitted.

It is the most comfy cute clothes thing in the shop and the one most likely to be worn three days running: leggings and trainers for the school run, boots and a long coat if it has to leave the house properly. If you want cute clothes to wear on a day you have decided not to try, this is it.

products.title: Glen Plaid Trench Coat
products.short: A black, white and pink glen plaid trench. Chest 40 inches, length 41 inches, sized L.
products.description:
Glen plaid in black and white with a thread of pink running through it — enough to lift the pattern out of the ordinary without making it a colour.

Cut as a proper trench, long to below the knee, in a fabric with enough weight to hang straight rather than flapping.

Chest 40 inches, length 41 inches. Sized L.

Over jeans and a knit it is the piece that makes the outfit; over tailoring it is the one that finishes it. It is the only full-length coat in the shop at the moment, and as a korean fashion winter coat it is the sort you buy once and wear for a decade. Korean fashion winter dressing is built on a long coat and good layers underneath, and this is the long coat.

products.title: Fleece-Lined High-Waisted Cropped Trousers
products.short: Beige high-waisted wide-leg trousers, fleece-lined, cropped at the ankle. Rise 12.5, inseam 25.5 inches.
products.description:
High at the waist, wide through the leg, and cut short on purpose — the hem lands above the ankle, which is what keeps a wide leg from reading as heavy.

They are fleece-lined, so they are considerably warmer than they look. The lining is smooth rather than brushed, so it does not add bulk at the thigh.

Elastic back waistband with a flat front. Rise 12.5 inches, inseam 25.5 inches. Two sizes on the waist.

Beige, which makes a tonal outfit easy and a black knit sharp. The cropped leg wants a boot or a loafer rather than a trainer. Among cute clothes for winter these are the trousers you can wear when it is genuinely cold without resorting to thermals, and as korean fashion pants the cropped wide leg is the proportion everything else is cut against.

products.title: Fleece-Lined Wide-Leg Corduroy Trousers
products.short: Fleece-lined corduroy wide-leg trousers in forest emerald or rich merlot. Rise 13 inches, inseam 25.
products.description:
Corduroy on the outside, soft fleece on the inside — the warmest trousers in the shop by some distance, and the reason they sell out before January.

Cut wide from a high waist with an elastic back panel, so there is nothing rigid at the middle. Rise 13 inches, inseam 25 inches, which puts the hem above the ankle.

Two colours worth the name: a forest emerald and a deep merlot red. Neither is a neutral, and both go with cream, camel and black without argument.

One size. A fitted knit on top keeps the proportion. As korean fashion pants they are the pair that makes a winter outfit, and the most practical cute clothes for cold weather thing we carry.

products.title: Lace-Hem A-Line Midi Skirt
products.short: A heavy A-line midi with a vintage lace hem, in deep brown or black. Elastic waist from 24 to 36 inches.
products.description:
A structured A-line in a heavy-gauge fabric, finished with a band of vintage-style lace at the hem. The lace is the only ornament and it changes the whole register of the skirt — without it this would be a plain winter midi.

The waistband is a wide elastic that runs from a 24 inch waist to 36, which is an unusually generous span and the reason it is sold as one size. It sits high and transitions smoothly into the flare.

Two colours: a deep saturated brown, and a black with no blue in it.

Boots and a denim jacket is the way it is usually worn and the lace stops that from reading as plain. Among cute clothes for winter it is warm without being bulky, and as a Korean fashion skirt it carries the detail where you can see it.

products.title: Corduroy Pinafore Dress
products.short: A brown corduroy pinafore with a gathered skirt and a high waist, cut to layer over a blouse or a knit.
products.description:
Brown corduroy, cut as a pinafore: straight bodice, wide straps, high gathered waist and a full skirt to mid-calf. There is nothing on top of the shoulders, which is the point — the blouse or the knit underneath is half the outfit and you can change it every day.

The cord is fine rather than chunky, so the skirt gathers properly instead of standing out stiffly. The waist sits high and is seamed, not elasticated, which gives the shape its line.

Cut to a US medium.

It is one of the most useful cute clothes for winter pieces we have had in: a high-neck blouse under it in October, a thin knit in January, a long-sleeved tee and boots the rest of the time. Korean fashion winter layering works like this — a plain base, one piece with a shape over it, done.

products.title: Embroidered Corduroy A-Line Skirt
products.short: A fine corduroy A-line scattered with small embroidered flowers, in sky blue or warm brown.
products.description:
Fine-wale corduroy cut as a simple A-line, with small flowers embroidered across it at intervals. They are stitched, not printed, so they sit slightly proud of the cord and catch the light.

The skirt itself is deliberately plain — no pleats, no tiers, nothing competing with the embroidery. It falls to mid-calf and keeps its shape because corduroy does.

Two colours: a clear sky blue, and a warm rich brown. One size.

A white tee and trainers is enough; the skirt is the outfit. It is the most straightforwardly aesthetic cute clothes piece in the shop, and the Korean fashion skirt that looks like it cost considerably more than it does.

products.title: Whimsical Wonder Embroidered Cardigan
products.short: A fine knit cardigan with small embroidered scenes scattered across the front, in beige, red, green or grey.
products.description:
Small embroidered motifs scattered across the front of a plain fine-knit cardigan — the kind of detail you only notice from a seat away, which is exactly why it works. Each one is stitched in contrasting thread.

The cardigan itself is deliberately simple: round neck, button front, ribbed cuffs and hem, nothing competing with the embroidery.

Four colours — beige, red, green and grey. One size.

Over a plain tee and jeans it does the whole job. It is the piece to point at when somebody asks where you get your cute clothes inspo, and a cute fashion style that reads as personal rather than bought.

products.title: Whisper Soft Faux Fur Vest
products.short: A short faux fur vest with a fine, soft pile and an open front. Cut to a US medium.
products.description:
A finer, softer pile than the plush vest — closer to a shearling than to a shaggy fur, and it sits flatter against whatever is underneath. Sleeveless, open at the front, cut short.

It adds warmth across the body and the shoulders without the weight of a coat, which is the reason to own one at all. Cruelty-free throughout.

Cut to a US medium.

Over a long-sleeved knit and jeans, or over something sleeveless for an evening. It is the korean fashion winter layer that makes a plain outfit look assembled, and the single most photographed thing in the shop around cute clothes for christmas season.

products.title: Ribbed Full-Zip Knit Cardigan
products.short: A ribbed knit cardigan with a full zip, a stand collar and two patch pockets. Oatmeal or black.
products.description:
Ribbed from collar to hem, zipped all the way up, with a small stand collar and two patch pockets low on the front. It is built like a sweatshirt and knitted like a cardigan, which is the combination most people actually want in October.

The rib gives it structure, so it keeps its shape through a day rather than hanging off the shoulders by lunchtime. The zip means it works open or closed without looking like you got it wrong.

Two colours: a soft oatmeal and a flat black. One size.

Jeans, a crossbody bag and trainers — that is the outfit, and the cardigan is what makes it look assembled. The most useful comfy cute clothes layer we sell, and the Korean fashion winter staple that is not a puffer.

products.title: Hooded Flannel Overshirt
products.short: A brushed flannel overshirt with a jersey hood, in blue, grey and tan check. Sized L.
products.description:
A brushed flannel check with a jersey hood sewn in at the collar — the combination that turns a shirt into a jacket without it becoming either one properly, which is the whole appeal.

Cut loose and long enough to wear open over a tee. Button front, chest pockets, and the flannel is soft from the first wear rather than needing six months of washing.

Blue, grey and tan run through the check, so it works over almost anything plain.

Sized L, cut generous. Over a white tee and jeans it is the easiest outfit in the shop. As a korean fashion jacket it is the most casual thing we carry, and among comfy cute clothes it is the one that gets left on the back of a chair and worn again tomorrow.

products.title: Flared Skater Skirt
products.short: A short flared skirt with a smooth elastic waist, in three colours that keep selling out.
products.description:
A short flared skirt that holds its shape without any stiffness in it. The waist is a covered elastic band, so there is no zip to sit on and nothing to adjust once it is on. It falls to just above the knee on most people and a little lower if you are petite.

We took three colours: black for the ones who wear black, a proper postbox red, and a cobalt blue that photographs brighter than it looks on the rail. All three are the same fabric — a double knit with enough body to swing when you turn.

It is one of the few things in the shop that works with trainers and with heels, which is why we keep reordering it. Runs small on the waist; take the next size up if you are between two.

It is the Korean fashion skirt people come in and describe rather than name — short, full, holds its shape.

products.title: Stop Worrying Slogan Sweatshirt
products.short: A cropped cotton sweatshirt with the print set large across the chest.
products.description:
A cropped sweatshirt in brushed cotton, cut boxy through the body with a dropped shoulder. The hem sits at the top of the hip, so it works over a high waist without bunching.

The print is set large and slightly off-centre, which is deliberate — it reads better on a body than it does flat on a hanger. We have it with the lettering in blue, in red and in a deep navy.

It washes well. Cold water, inside out, and the print stays as it arrived.

It sits in the part of the rail we think of as comfy cute clothes: things you put on without deciding anything.

products.title: Cat Motif Cardigan
products.short: A cream V-neck cardigan with cats knitted into the body and a contrast placket.
products.description:
A cream cardigan with the cats knitted in rather than printed on, which is the difference between something that survives a winter and something that does not. The placket and cuffs are picked out in black, and the buttons are a dark horn look.

It is a true V-neck and sits at the hip, so it buttons over a tee without riding up. The yarn is soft but has enough twist that it is not going to pill in the first month.

One of those pieces people buy for themselves and then come back for as a gift.

It is on the shelf we fill with cute clothes for winter, and it does not stay there long.

products.title: Belted Shirt Dress
products.short: A long shirt dress with a self-tie belt and a full skirt below the waist seam.
products.description:
A shirt dress cut long, with a waist seam and a self-tie belt that you can leave loose or pull in. The skirt below it is full enough to move but not so full that it reads as formal.

The collar is soft and the buttons run the whole way down, which means you can wear it open over trousers as a light coat. Sleeves are long with a buttoned cuff.

Cream, black, taupe and grey. The taupe is warmer in person than it photographs.

It is the Korean fashion casual dress we are asked for most, usually by someone who saw it on somebody else.

products.title: Wool-Blend Long Coat
products.short: A long, collarless wool-blend coat with a clean front and no belt.
products.description:
A long coat with nothing on it: no belt, no epaulettes, a single row of concealed buttons. The line runs straight from the shoulder to just below the knee.

The cloth is a wool blend with enough body to hold that line in a wind. It is lined to the hem and there are two welt pockets set low, where your hands actually go.

Cream. It is the piece in the shop we would keep if we could only keep one.

A Korean fashion winter coat in the plainest sense: one good cloth, one good line, nothing else.

products.title: Quilted Liner Jacket
products.short: A light diamond-quilted jacket that layers under a coat or stands on its own.
products.description:
A diamond-quilted jacket with a light fill — warm enough on its own in autumn, thin enough to go under a coat in winter without bulking out the shoulder.

It buttons rather than zips, which keeps it looking like a jacket instead of a liner. Two patch pockets, a soft stand collar, and elastic at the cuff.

Cream and a sage green. The sage is closer to olive in daylight.

products.title: Washed Denim Jeans
products.short: Mid-blue washed denim in a straight cut, with the fading done properly.
products.description:
Straight-cut jeans in a mid-blue wash, faded through the thigh and seat rather than printed to look that way. The denim has a little stretch, enough to sit down in without the knees going.

Five pockets, a button fly, and a waistband that sits at the natural waist rather than below it. The leg is straight from the knee down.

We buy denim a few pairs at a time, so sizes go quickly and do not always come back.

Korean fashion jeans tend to sit higher and cut straighter than most, and these do both.

products.title: Ampoule Sheet Mask
products.short: Single-use ampoule sheet masks, sold one at a time so you can try the whole set.
products.description:
Cotton sheet masks soaked in an ampoule rather than a watery essence, so there is enough left in the sachet to press into your neck and the backs of your hands afterwards.

Five to choose from. Cica for skin that is reacting to something, hyaluronic acid for flat and tired skin, vitamin for dullness, arbutin for marks left behind by old spots, and tea tree for an oily week.

Twenty minutes is plenty. There is no need to rinse.
